task: You are hungry! Let's cook a delicious meal. Check the cookbook in the kitchen for the recipe. Once done, enjoy your meal!
description:
You are in a kitchen. An usual kind of place.

You can make out a fridge. You see an oven. You can see a table. Why don't you take a picture of it, it'll last longer! The table is massive. On the table you can see a cookbook. There's something strange about this being here, but you can't put your finger on it. You make out a counter. On the counter you see a knife. You scan the room, seeing a stove. But the thing hasn't got anything on it. It would have been so cool if there was stuff on the stove.
inventory: You are carrying: a raw pork chop.

feedback: You are carrying: a raw pork chop.
